div.p: The one fully wired calculation path.

g.text: ureg.define('barg = 1*bar; offset: ambient_pressure') — from Options panel, mirrors 1_straight_through.py
build kwargs_guarantee (suction, discharge, speed, flow, gas)
build per-test-point kwargs (ps, Ts, pd, Td, flow, speed)
extract — pressure_ratio = disch.p/suc.p, head, eff, disch_p, power, Mach, Reynolds
build 6 Plotly figs (Mach, Reynolds, Head, Eff, Discharge Pressure, Power)

ul.li: bearing_mechanical_losses=False — oil/seal-gas/casing-heat-loss branches are not wired yet.
Streamlit page ccp/app/pages/1_straight_through.py (~line 638) is the source of truth.
Point.pressure_ratio is None by default; the extract step computes it.
